title: Shiguang Dailiren
synopsis:
It is said that a picture is worth a thousand words. In this case, it holds an infinite amount of secrets. These are secrets that only Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang are able to find. In a small shop called "Time Photo Studio," the two friends provide a special service: using their extraordinary powers that let them enter photographs, they jump into pictures brought to them by clients in order to grant their wishes. Through the eyes of the photographer, they live through the events surrounding the picture and try to decipher how to solve their client's request.

But every time they jump into a picture, they take a great risk. One wrong move and they could alter the future of the person who took the picture... and possibly countless other events too. So when the events they are forced to live through in these pictures start to become personal, it will take the utmost strength to push their feelings aside and focus on accomplishing the task they were paid to do.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

episodes_data.title: Emma
episodes_data.description: In order to obtain evidence of falsified financial reports, Cheng Xiaoshi entered the world of photos taken by Emma, an employee of VIcky Games, under the command of Lu Guang.

episodes_data.title: Secret Recipe
episodes_data.description: Yuxia, owner of a chain restaurant company finds the timing duo hoping to obtain the secret soup recipe secretly kept by partner Lin Zhen.

episodes_data.title: To Lose, Not to Win
episodes_data.description: Cheng Xiao entered the photo with the regret of his client when he was young, and played a special basketball game.

episodes_data.title: Confess
episodes_data.description: The commission went on smoothly, but Cheng Xiaoshi gradually realized that this mission was directed towards an unspeakable memory.

episodes_data.title: Farewell
episodes_data.description: Facing the irreversible past, Cheng Xiaoshi wanted to change their future.

episodes_data.title: Search of the Child
episodes_data.description: Police Xiao Li came to the door and commissioned it, hoping to use the capabilities of Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang to investigate a child abduction case.

episodes_data.title: Aunt May
episodes_data.description: Doudou`s whereabouts are at a loss, but Cheng Xiaoshi`s persistence brought a turn for the case.

episodes_data.title: Lost Signal
episodes_data.description: In addition to solving emotional problems for Qiao Ling`s friend Xu Shanshan, Time Photo Studio received an "unexpected joy".

episodes_data.title: Consequence of Goodwill
episodes_data.description: Xu Shanshan`s disappearance was not simple. At the same time, Lu Guang discovered unexpected clues from the photos.

episodes_data.title: Trap
episodes_data.description: To protect Xu Shanshan`s safety, Cheng Xiaoshi made a "deal" with the murderer.

episodes_data.title: Pinnacle of Light
episodes_data.description: The serial murderer was finally arrested, but the battle for Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang was not over yet.

specials_data.title: Marrying by Contesting
specials_data.description: In order to marry Ouyang, the daughter of the master of martial arts, Siwen commissioned the Time Photo Studio to help him crack the master`s unique martial arts.

specials_data.title: Troubles of Ordinary People
specials_data.description: Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang use superpowers to enter clientele’s photos one by one, no matter how dangerous. Welcome to “Time Photo Studio”!
